what: A long scroll range is divided equally by the number of photos, and only the current slot’s photo is pinned full screen and turned on. On entering the slot it fades in over .5s (power1.out) while shrinking from 1.1 to 1. On leaving, it grows back to 1.1x along the same path and fades out, so adjacent photos overlap as they swap. Photos sit behind the pinned panel (z -2), so a logo or text can float above them

options.--fx-photo-z: z-index (css) of the photo layer, default -2

use: …
note: The section length (height of the attached element) is set by the user — the original is 8 times the 2083px screen for 10 photos. Photos are position: fixed, so use it on a page that scrolls the window
